# Katalog Aset GELITA (public site)

The public catalogue of every picture, music track, sound effect and narration the game uses, served at <https://katalog.gelita.id/> from a repository checkout. Rebuilt on 17 November 2026 (owner) as a page generated by a command; nothing here is kept by hand.

The folder holds only the page and its list (about 300 KB). It copies no picture or sound: every entry is shown from the file the live game serves on <https://gelita.id/> (owner, 17 November 2026: the repository must not grow with asset files).

**Everything here is generated.** Do not edit the files; change the sources and run:

```bash
php spark gelita:katalog:halaman --dry-run   # what would change
php spark gelita:katalog:halaman             # write this folder (only what changed)
php spark gelita:katalog:halaman --cek       # exit 1 when this folder is stale
php spark gelita:katalog:halaman --cek-tautan  # which linked files gelita.id does not have yet
php spark gelita:katalog:halaman --basis=URL   # link to another install (default https://gelita.id)
```

Then commit the folder. `tests/unit/CatalogSiteTest.php` fails while the committed folder does not match its sources, so a picture, review mark, sound or narration take that changes is rebuilt in the same branch.

## What is here

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `index.html`, `katalog.css`, `katalog.js` | The page: tabs Gambar, Musik, Efek suara, Narasi; search and filters (category, region, challenge kind, review status; narration part, region, speaker); a detail view per picture; a link to *Mengenal GELITA* on gelita.id. Copied from `app/Libraries/CatalogSite/` |
| `data.js` | The list (`window.KATALOG`), one entry per line: the base URL, and per picture its asset keys, where it is used (from `ImageSlots`), its original size, its review status and notes from `ai-studio/game-images/REVIEW.md`, and its path on the server |

Where a file lives on the server follows the game's own storage: installed slot pictures `assets/uploads/{slot key}.webp` (app icons `.png`, story backgrounds under their slide key `bg.story.{context}[.{region}].{n}`), shipped UI art `assets/ui/` and `assets/app/`, music and sound effects `assets/audio/{music,sfx}/`, narration `assets/audio/narasi/{id,en}/{code}.mp3`. A file the server does not have yet (not installed, not deployed) shows *Belum ada di gelita.id*; a picture the game never installs (style references, the video entries of Pustaka) shows *Belum dipasang di permainan*. The entry stays listed either way. The page uses the system fonts.

## Rules

- **Everything public** (owner, 17 November 2026): answer-revealing challenge pictures and test stimuli included, the risk accepted by the owner (gelita.id serves these files publicly anyway). The picture masters in `ai-studio/game-images/` are never served or linked.
- **No copies.** No picture, sound or font file goes into this folder; a rebuild deletes any.
- **No prompt texts.** The prompts in `data.json` and `sounds.csv` stay in `ai-studio/`.
- **Pictures:** every file of `ai-studio/game-images/data.json` (frame 1 of each character pose only, since the game moves to one still picture per pose), the mock-up pictures the importer installs (`CatalogImporter::MOCKUP_FILES`, `MOCKUP_DIRS`), and the UI art that ships with the game (`public/assets/ui/`, `public/assets/app/`). Style references are listed too, marked as not installed.
- **Review status** comes from the Status column of `REVIEW.md`: `keep` → *Dipertahankan*, `fixed` → *Sudah diperbaiki*, `redo` → *Akan dibuat ulang*, `redo later` → *Dibuat ulang nanti*, `drop` → *Akan dihapus*, empty → *Belum ditinjau*. The review is the developer's own check, not expert validation; the page says so.
- **Audio:** music and sound effects of `public/assets/audio/{music,sfx}/` with the screen and mood of `ai-studio/elevenlabs-sound/sounds.csv`; every narration line of `ai-studio/elevenlabs-voice/lines.csv`, in both languages.

## On the server

The web server serves this folder of a checkout that is updated with `git pull`. `docs/08_DEPLOYMENT.md` → *The public Katalog Aset site* has the steps (nginx `index index.html;`, Cloudflare cache purge).
